alerts.area: West Side of Fresno and Kings Counties; Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma; Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore; Visalia - Porterville - Reedley
alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 20 at 2:47AM PST until November 20 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma, Hanford - Corcoran -
Lemoore, Visalia - Porterville - Reedley, and West Side of Fresno
and Kings Counties.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
